name: Ira Domitriev
original_name: イーラ・ドミトリエワ
source:
Affiliation: ICSEO - Fair Messenger
Post: Captain
Birthplace: Russia (Khabarovsk)

Captain of the enemies main ship. Like the protagonist she became the captain because of her famous soldier father, but unlike the protagonist she is a cold woman who is strict to everyone even herself.
